item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03215","case1_error":"Reports 200 pairs instead of the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Evaluates 30 + 2 × 15 as 70 instead of 60, propagating the error.","reason":"The first answers the wrong quantity; the second incorrectly evaluates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03216","case1_error":"Gives an unsupported final answer of 13 after correct average formulas; the average is 9.","case2_error":"Divides average weights by group sizes instead of multiplying to obtain total weights.","reason":"The first supplies an incorrect number without showing its calculation; the second explicitly substitutes incorrect operations into total-weight relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03217","case1_error":"Lists unsupported final numbers after correct deposit formulas, which yield $1,110.","case2_error":"Calculates grooming time for only one dog, omitting the second dog.","reason":"Unsupported numerical answers after correct formulas differ from computing only one dog's contribution to the requested total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03218","case1_error":"Writes profit per mile with division applying only to gas cost, then asserts an unsupported $100 total.","case2_error":"Applies the doubled fuel capacity twice, producing $960 instead of $480.","reason":"The first contains a misplaced division scope and an unsupported result; the second explicitly double-counts the capacity increase.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03219","case1_error":"Uses an incorrect conversion factor of 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported $260 final answer after correct tax formulas, which yield $230.","reason":"An explicitly incorrect unit conversion differs from an unsupported numerical answer following correct formulas.","judgment":"different"}]}
